# Pure Dephasing Bound Entanglement

> A complete scientific account of PPT bound-entanglement generation from fully product system inputs by Hamiltonian-free, time-homogeneous correlated pure dephasing, with a Gaussian covariance correspondence and rigorous finite-qubit certificates.

## Start here

- [Repository overview](README.md): question, principal results, physical scope, learning route and reproduction commands.
- [Scientific overview](science/README.md): connected proof route and how the Gaussian and finite-spin arguments fit together.

## Questions and authoritative answers

- What does pure dephasing mean here, and why can quantum correlations differ from classical phase noise? Read [the model](science/model.md), including the exact kernel, coefficient matrix, partial-transpose generator and oscillator evolution.
- How does a Gaussian target determine a dephasing semigroup? Read [reservoir embedding](science/reservoir-embedding.md), especially the conventions and theorem, finite-time dilation, local canonical extraction, separability and PPT proofs.
- What is actually extracted, and which resources are required? The same [embedding account](science/reservoir-embedding.md#resources-interpretation-and-limitations) states the finite-time additive noise, reservoir correlations, local decoder, input squeezing and energy cost.
- Why does the witness rule out every separable state, including non-Gaussian states? Read [covariance witnesses](science/covariance-witnesses.md). The local commutator expectations belong to the tested state.
- Where is the explicit 2,048-qubit example? Read [the four-mode and finite-qubit certificate](science/four-mode-certificate.md), then the matching exact verification program and stored rational inputs.
- Why does an oscillator witness survive at a finite spin-group size? Read [finite-spin transfer](science/finite-spin-transfer.md), with the exact moments, magnetizations and separate covariance-score and uncertainty-threshold error bounds.
- Which perturbations are certified? Read [robustness](science/robustness.md). The coefficient box and added group-dephasing intervals are separate guarantees.
- Which ingredients are inherited? Read [related work](references/RELATED_WORK.md) and the [structured bibliography](references/references.bib).

## Study route

The single educational anchor is Weedbrook et al., Gaussian Quantum Information, Rev. Mod. Phys. 84, 621–669 (2012). Section references use arXiv:1110.3234v1.

- [Weedbrook bridge](learning/WEEDBROOK_BRIDGE.md): relevant source sections, quadrature/covariance dictionary, worked example and missing steps to the research results.
- [30-milestone map](learning/MILESTONES.md): 12 background/preliminaries milestones followed by 18 narrative/innovation milestones, with stable M01–M30 identifiers, conceptual dependencies and source pointers.

These are common scientific learning materials. They do not prescribe a reader's assessment history or establish mastery.

## Reproduction route

Start with [the verification guide](verification/README.md). Install its pinned requirements and run the five documented programs. The committed JSON certificates retain exact rational inputs and bounds. The analytic witness-region figure has its own documented generator and plotting requirements.

Finite exact checks establish their stated instances and algebraic identities. General quantifiers, local extraction and convergence are established by the written proofs and their cited ingredients.

## Distinctions to preserve

- The system input is fully product. Reservoir quantum correlations or collective nonlocal couplings supply the entanglement resource.
- The original reduced generator has zero system Hamiltonian. The microscopic dilation contains local system–reservoir interactions, and the transposed description may have a Hamiltonian term.
- PPT and entanglement are certified across the same specified bipartition. PPT across every other cut is not asserted.
- The exact separability/PPT equivalences concern the constructed Gaussian covariance family. The general transpose-coefficient test is presented as a sufficient condition outside that family.
- The Gaussian target, carrier oscillators and finite spin groups are distinct systems. A target with r modes uses 2r carrier oscillators in the general construction.
- Finite-time extraction returns the target plus explicit additive noise. Exact asymptotic recovery carries increasing resource costs.
- The finite-spin proof uses actual magnetization-dependent commutators and convergence of moments and witnesses; it does not claim a full-state or full-channel oscillator limit.
- The 2,048-qubit certificate is an exact existence result. The larger general sufficient-size bound and separate eight-group example do not establish an optimal size.
- Generic Gaussian reservoir transfer and PPT-preserving entangling Gaussian channels have precedents. The scientific contribution concerns the restricted pure-dephasing semigroup and its finite-spin realization.
